GREAT Scholarships at Course List College

Course List College is offering GREAT Scholarship for the 2026-27 academic year, each worth £10,000.

Scholarships are available for students from:

  • India
  • Malaysia

These scholarships are available for a taught master's programme in the following subjects:

  • LLM Law
  • LLM Law and Technology
